data.one_liner: Tool to view all dependencies and their licenses in your Dart or Flutter project.
data.what_it_does: It inspects your dependencies and displays a table showing their names and associated licenses. You can also view transitive dependencies using a specific flag.
use_when: You need to audit the licenses of your project's dependencies
You want to check both direct and transitive dependencies
avoid_when: You need a package for in-app runtime state or UI rendering
strengths: Simple CLI usage via pub global activate
Supports displaying transitive dependencies via a flag
data.setup_notes: Activate globally using `flutter pub global activate dart_license_checker` and ensure your PATH is set up correctly.
